release.name: MultiOmics Research v1
release.sourceIdentity: The immutable release identity is the final merged main commit SHA recorded in the Research v1 release note and/or Git tag; this manifest intentionally avoids a self-referential commit SHA.

nativeRConfirmatoryEligibility: supported two-group differential designs with complete native R tables
supported repeated group-by-time longitudinal designs with complete lmerTest tables
supported independent survival designs with complete survival::coxph tables
notConfirmatoryInResearchV1: MOFA2 or DIABLO latent/supervised integration as confirmatory causal inference

requiredEvidence: public Airway native-R replay and reproducible R Markdown
real Sacurine v3 twelve-mzML xcms/QC/blank qualification
external real-data NKI DMFS Cox wrapper-vs-direct qualification
external real-data GSE191328 longitudinal wrapper-vs-direct qualification

knownOpenScientificLimitations.releaseEffect: Does not block Research v1 software freeze because the UI and reports explicitly refuse universal FDR certification; does block any claim that DESeq2 q-values guarantee nominal 5% FDR for arbitrary studies.

knownOpenScientificLimitations.topic: LC-MS analytical validation beyond successful real raw-data execution
knownOpenScientificLimitations.releaseEffect: Does not block raw-MS software execution qualification; does block claims of chemical identity, validated drift/carryover correction, interlaboratory analytical accuracy, or universally valid downstream QC filtering.

knownOpenScientificLimitations.topic: Externally transferable individual biological signatures for Omics2PK
knownOpenScientificLimitations.releaseEffect: Does not block MultiOmics Research v1; does block claims that exported individual signatures are biologically validated PK/PD covariates.

externalHumanTasks: independent statistician/biologist review of study-specific analyses
institutional privacy/authorization review for confidential datasets
releaseBoundary: A green Research v1 release proves the tested software, provenance and fail-closed contracts at the frozen source revision. It does not certify a study design, statistical calibration, biological truth, causal interpretation, biomarker performance, PK/PD benefit or clinical use.
